skill.description: AIが生成した日本語を推敲するスキル。利用者が yomiyasu の名前を出して頼んだとき（「/yomiyasu」、「$yomiyasu:yomiyasu」、「yomiyasu で推敲して」など）と、スキルを使った日本語の推敲をはっきり頼んだときだけ使う。CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md、カスタム指示などで yomiyasu を使うよう求められているときも、名前を出して頼まれたものとして扱う。名前を出さずに日本語の文章を書かせる依頼や、コード、設定、ドキュメントの更新では使わない。意味と条件を保ち、不自然な比喩、曖昧な主述関係、不要な装飾やコピー調を整える。

content.user_title: Refine Japanese Drafts With Meaning-Preserving Checks
content.value_statement: AI-generated Japanese can contain unclear relationships, excessive decoration, and wording that changes the intended message. Yomiyasu combines contextual editing guidance with local lint, comparison, and final-draft verification checks.
actual_capabilities: Guides Japanese revisions while preserving claims, conditions, uncertainty, numbers, and the function of each sentence.
Flags candidate issues in Japanese wording, punctuation, headings, emphasis, and Markdown formatting.
Compares original and revised drafts for potential changes to meaning, tone, certainty, names, and numbers.
Applies guidance for 13 document types, three reader knowledge levels, and explicitly supplied writer-reader relationships.
Compares drafts with supplied materials and identifies candidate factual gaps without treating matches as proof.
Creates local check records and verifies that the submitted draft matches the recorded final-draft hash.
limitations: Automated findings are review candidates, not guarantees of factual accuracy, readability, or preserved meaning.
Automated checks require Python; manual review must be reported separately when Python is unavailable.
Markdown inspection is limited and does not guarantee identical rendering across all platforms.
Recorded runs retain local document copies and reports; hashes do not prevent tampering by users with write access.

use_cases.title: Review Technical Change Descriptions
use_cases.description: Refine Japanese pull request descriptions while preserving identifiers, completed changes, limitations, and test results.

use_cases.title: Polish Business Correspondence
use_cases.description: Improve Japanese emails while retaining deadlines, request strength, and the explicitly stated relationship with the recipient.

use_cases.title: Edit Articles Without Adding Claims
use_cases.description: Revise Japanese articles for a specified audience and identify statements that require clarification or supporting material.

prompt_templates.title: Revise a Short Passage
prompt_templates.prompt: Use yomiyasu to revise this Japanese passage. Preserve its meaning and certainty, and explain the main edits: [passage].

prompt_templates.title: Polish an External Email
prompt_templates.prompt: Use yomiyasu on this Japanese email to an external client. Preserve the deadline and request strength. Do not add promises: [email].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: adapt wording to an explicit recipient relationship.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Technical Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use yomiyasu on [draft path] as a technical article for informed readers. Save a separate revision and report lint, comparison, and verification results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review a file with document and audience settings.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Revision Against Materials
prompt_templates.prompt: Use yomiyasu to revise [draft path] using [material path]. Preserve conditions, numbers, and uncertainty. Cite factual corrections, identify unresolved conflicts, and verify the final file.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine contextual editing, supplied evidence, and final-draft verification.

output_examples.input: Revise this Japanese sentence: 設定の確認を実施することが可能です。
output_examples.output:
設定を確認できます。

Change: Simplified the nominalized wording while preserving the statement of capability.

output_examples.input: Revise this Japanese sentence without strengthening the claim: 通信が切れた場合だけ、再送することが可能です。
output_examples.output:
通信が切れた場合だけ、再送できます。

Change: Shortened the wording while preserving both the condition and the statement of capability.

output_examples.input: Review this Japanese change note without inventing a measurement: 応答が大幅に速くなりました。
output_examples.output:
応答が大幅に速くなりました。

Question for the author: What measurements support this comparison?

No numerical result was added.

best_practices: Provide the original draft, intended audience, document type, and any source materials that support factual statements.
Review every suggested change against the original, especially conditions, numbers, responsibility, and uncertainty.
Keep originals separate and inspect local records; request no-record operation when document retention is inappropriate.
anti_patterns: Treating zero lint findings or a matching hash as proof of quality or factual accuracy.
Applying every candidate change automatically without checking the surrounding context.
Providing credentials or confidential materials that the intended recipient is not authorized to receive.

faq.question: When does yomiyasu activate?
faq.answer: It activates when explicitly named or clearly requested for Japanese revision, including explicit project instructions.

faq.question: Does it support different document types?
faq.answer: Yes. Guidance covers 13 types, including technical articles, emails, incident reports, meeting minutes, formal documents, papers, essays, and scripts.

faq.question: Does it require Python?
faq.answer: Python is required for automated lint, comparison, and verification. Editorial review can continue without it, but omitted checks must be reported.

faq.question: Does it guarantee that meaning is preserved?
faq.answer: No. Its guidance prioritizes meaning preservation, but automated candidates and final-draft hashes cannot prove semantic equivalence.

faq.question: Where are check records stored?
faq.answer: Recorded runs normally store document copies and reports in a local .yomiyasu folder. The state directory is configurable, and no-record operation is available.

faq.question: Does it research missing facts online?
faq.answer: No. Fact recovery uses permitted conversation context and local materials, excludes credential files, and asks about unresolved gaps.
